slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 fell to 7,631 today, down 0.71%, as fresh US strikes on Iran pushed oil prices higher and sent bond yields up, which makes future corporate profits worth less in today's dollars. The VIX, which measures how much fear is priced into the market, jumped 9.5% to 16.34, a sign investors grew notably more nervous. Japan's Nikkei dropped 2.90% and Korea fell 3.61%, with global markets broadly selling off on the same inflation fears. The big jobs report, known as Non-Farm Payrolls, comes Friday and will be the next thing to move markets.
